canonical.title: Testing & regression-checking Claude Code agent extensions before you ship them

siblings.title: Testing an authored Claude Code Skill before you ship it to a team
siblings.summary: The two things to test are separable — does the description trigger, and does the body behave — and in 2026 the de-facto harness is Anthropic's skill-creator eval loop plus a with-skill/without-skill baseline; everything else is thin.

siblings.title: Smoke-testing a Claude Code subagent's routing before you ship it
siblings.summary: Promptfoo's claude-agent-sdk provider plus headless stream-json are the only real ways to assert subagent routing in 2026; the description field is the trigger, parent_tool_use_id is the proof.

siblings.title: Regression-testing Claude Code plugins & MCP servers, and catching rug-pulls
siblings.summary: Two test surfaces — functional schema/contract drift and supply-chain rug-pulls — with the 2026 tooling that catches each, and an honest map of where the defenses are still missing.

siblings.title: The lightweight per-PR floor for testing Claude Code agent extensions
siblings.summary: A small team's realistic per-PR floor for testing Claude Code skills/plugins/MCP config: deterministic schema and frontmatter linting first, one cheap headless model check second.

siblings.title: Testing Claude Code Hooks Before Shipping to a Team
siblings.summary: Hooks are plain scripts with a documented stdin/exit-code/JSON contract — the one Claude Code extension you can test with fully-deterministic CI.
